title: Patient medication error
goal: Show clinical barriers around incorrect intravenous medication administration.

rubric.must: A named hazard and the central top event Incorrect medication or dose administered are visible.
Multiple labelled threats through preventative barriers visibly lead from the left to the top event.
Multiple labelled consequences through mitigative barriers visibly lead from the top event to the right.
An escalation factor and its barrier are visibly attached beneath a named preventive barrier.
The picture has a clear left-threat, central-event, right-consequence bowtie geometry.
Individual barrier labels are readable and distinguish prevention from mitigation.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/bowtie/ideal.svg (sha256 4484bd18b387), source sha256 e26d6fafbc4e. Role-coloured threats and consequences, neutral prevention/mitigation chains, green top-event disc, hazard header, and a separately attached escalation/control chain; all declared barriers retained. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
